observation.transcript:
Log in

1. You said:
tell me about sparrow wells and reading a book with lee
2. ChatGPT said:
I found something that appears to match both names: Sparrow Wells is credited as a creator/author, and Reading a Book with Lee is described as a long-form, experimental video/“patacinematic” project involving Lee Sharks. The material is archived on Zenodo and was created in 2026. ZZenodo
Sparrow Wells
Sparrow Wells is listed as being affiliated with the Studio for Patacinematics and is credited with the series concept and production scripts for Reading a Book with Lee. The archive describes the work as a deliberately unusual experiment in attention, duration, and observation. ZZenodo
Reading a Book with Lee
The basic premise is almost comically simple: Lee Sharks silently reads a book on camera for 57 minutes, with no narration, commentary, music, or camera cuts. The book itself isn't identified. ZZenodo
The project then turns that simple act into something much more conceptual. The archive includes:
   * a production script for the 57-minute episode
   * analysis of viewers' reactions to tiny movements and sounds
   * a proposed 4.5-hour film built around the same concept
   * writing about attention, intimacy, surveillance, and duration
   * a recursive idea in which Lee eventually reads transcripts describing himself reading
So it's less about what Lee is reading and more about what happens when watching someone read becomes the entire subject. ZZenodo
One interesting detail is that the archive explicitly presents the project as having distributed human/AI authorship, with Wells, Lee Sharks, Gemini, and other named contributors involved in different portions of the work. ZZenodo
Reading a Book with Lee — complete archive on Zenodo
If you meant a particular Sparrow Wells book, person, or project other than this, tell me what you remember about it and I can dig further.
ZSources
